narr: A slow moving warm front combined with several upper level disturbances generated clusters of showers and thunderstorms that produced locally heavy rain and flooding.
ev: River Road was washed out near Brady Road due to a rapid rise of the nearby Styx River. The nearby Styx River gauge at Smith's Landing rose 10 feet from 11pm on the 9th to 9am on the 10th.
lsr: RIVER ROAD WAS WASHED OUT NEAR BRADY ROAD DUE TO A RAPID RISE OF THE NEARBY STYX RIVER. THE NEARBY STYX RIVER GAUGE AT SMITHS LANDING ROSE 10 FEET FROM 11PM TO 9AM.
